definitions.explanation: The act of changing or correcting written content, replacing old text or data with new content.

definitions.gloss: renewal; reissuing (of a document or license)
definitions.explanation: The process of updating or renewing an official document, license, or certificate by replacing it with a new one.

examples.japanese: データの{書|か}き{換|か}えが{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: The data needs to be rewritten.

examples.japanese: {歴史|れきし}の{書|か}き{換|か}えは{許|ゆる}されない。
{不正|ふせい}にデータを{書|か}き{換|か}えた{疑|うたが}いで{調査|ちょうさ}が{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: An investigation was conducted on suspicion of fraudulently altering the data.

examples.japanese: {免許|めんきょ}の{書|か}き{換|か}えに{行|い}く。
examples.english: I'm going to renew my license.

examples.japanese: パスポートの{書|か}き{換|か}え{手続|てつづ}きをした。
examples.english: I completed the passport renewal procedure.

examples.japanese: {運転免許証|うんてんめんきょしょう}の{書|か}き{換|か}えは{誕生日|たんじょうび}の{前後|ぜんご}{一|いっ}か{月|げつ}に{行|おこな}える。
examples.english: You can renew your driver's license within one month before or after your birthday.

notes:
Noun form of the verb {書|か}き{換|か}える (to rewrite, to renew). Also written as {書|か}き{替|か}え.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- データの{書|か}き{換|か}え: data rewriting/overwriting
- {免許|めんきょ}の{書|か}き{換|か}え: license renewal
- パスポートの{書|か}き{換|か}え: passport renewal
- {歴史|れきし}の{書|か}き{換|か}え: rewriting of history

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {更新|こうしん}: renewal, updating (more formal/official; preferred in bureaucratic contexts)
- {変更|へんこう}: change, modification (broader meaning)
- {修正|しゅうせい}: correction, revision

USAGE:
For license renewal (sense 2), {更新|こうしん} is more common in official contexts, but {書|か}き{換|か}え is widely used in everyday speech.
